The Type 2 FAQ ties the revenue claim to dated examples (e.g. 'has turned away revenue on principle, including ads in 2026'), not an undated habit. research_tasks names post-IPO filings and earnings-call remarks as the place to look for her first-person account of such a trade-off.

assessment: Five-year verdict: the core thesis passes, with tracking gaps. The Type 1 versus Type 2 argument draws on dated first-person evidence from 2021 to 2026 across at least eight venues: the 2021 feedback matrix, board reviews and 'get myself out of that job' (Grit, February 2024), turned-away customers (Stanford, 2024), integrity and the culture interview (Sixth Street, February 2026), no ads (Oprah, May 2026). It survives removing the October 2026 sources, the S-1 and the Pentagon episode. The hook is a non-news detail. The OpenAI-era allegations are explicitly non-load-bearing. Absolute dates are used almost everywhere ('By June 2026', S-1 filing date, age as of September 30, 2026, birth year only). The weak points: (1) the revenue-under-principle discriminator has no review triggers right as the IPO begins to test it; (2) the sibling contrast and the Dario FAQ rest on a single interview dated 2026-10-27; (3) several present-tense role claims, plus the occupation and persona_title metadata, are uninventoried or marked stable; (4) one undated 'has not given her own account'; (5) a February 2024 board-review claim now sits beside her S-1 chair role; (6) two fragile citation links; (7) an untracked dependency on Dario's page staying Type 6. All are cheap evidence-record and wording fixes; none requires changing the thesis. Similarity advisory: not tripped. The top pairs (max 0.051, at the noise-floor maximum) share only attribution scaffolding such as 'she told a ... audience in 2026' and generic Type 1 phrasing, with no shared argument. I found no meaningful reuse. The short 'pattern runs in a few plain steps' explainer is ordinary type vocabulary. Risk flags match the evidence record: sensitive allegations (the coup accusation and 'abusing her power'), contested typing (medium confidence, with Type 2 live), and a major thesis change from the 2026-10-06 Type 2 hold.
